in_sanskrit.name: Ketul
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Moon
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ketul एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Ketul is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ketu', which represents the Moon's tail in Hindu astrology. The name carries a spiritual significance, symbolizing protection, guidance, and the influence of the moon on one's life.
